description: This is a modern 'Prometheus' dashboard for your Kubernetes cluster(s). Made for kube-prometheus-stack and take advantage of the latest Grafana features. GitHub repository: https://github.com/dotdc/grafana-dashboards-kubernetes

targets.expr: sum by (instance, scrape_job) (rate(prometheus_target_sync_length_seconds_sum{job="prometheus"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (instance, scrape_job) (rate(prometheus_target_sync_length_seconds_count{job="prometheus"}[$__rate_interval])) * 1000

panels.title: Average Target Sync Duration by scrape_job

targets.expr: (sum by (instance) (prometheus_tsdb_storage_blocks_bytes{job="prometheus"}) + sum by (instance) (prometheus_tsdb_wal_storage_size_bytes{job="prometheus"}) + sum by (instance) (prometheus_tsdb_head_chunks_storage_size_bytes{job="prometheus"})) / (sum by (instance) (prometheus_tsdb_retention_limit_bytes{job="prometheus"}) > 0)

panels.title: Storage - TSDB size, % of retention size limit
panels.description: TSDB size (blocks + WAL + head chunks) as a percentage of the retention size limit (--storage.tsdb.retention.size). Shows data only when a size limit is configured: with time-only retention Prometheus reports a limit of 0, which is skipped instead of dividing by zero.

panels.title: Storage - TSDB size and retention size limit
